scope: Public initializer source and separate ordinary native-probe login setup only

findings.claim: The four fixed schema roles are NOLOGIN groups. The conversation journal uses eva_runtime and the operational timeline explicitly executes SET LOCAL ROLE eva_runtime before model work. A DBOS-only login does not satisfy this contract.

The source change rejects fixed group names as application logins and reports the supplied separate login. It does not add provisioning, role grants, ownership, schema mutation, fixture changes or budget changes.

A separate restricted login with explicit SET membership on eva_runtime and eva_dbos matches the existing runtime contract and PostgreSQL 16 role semantics. INHERIT FALSE prevents automatic inheritance; SET TRUE permits the required explicit switch.

approvedSetup.restore: Restore eva_dbos to NOLOGIN only in this retained isolated probe cluster; preserve the other fixed-role flags.
approvedSetup.preserve: Retained database/schema/data, cache, controls, images and original numeric experiment bounds. Do not rerun initialize_scope, reseed or rewrite the nonempty database.
exclusions: No admin, migrator or backup membership
No new ownership or DDL rights

required: Recheck exact retained isolated database/container before grants
Verify actual restricted login flags and session_user/current_database
Verify SET-enabled, non-inherited, non-admin membership only in the required role groups; no indirect administrative membership or ownership
Verify both explicit SET LOCAL ROLE switches in rollback transactions before the same public synthetic fixture is continued
preHTTPVerification.note: The initializer validates configured username/database only; runtimeDatabaseRole is not proof of actual PostgreSQL flags or ability. Live checks are to be preserved in p2-native-runtime-ingress-corrected-20261006.json.
